rule: Every proposed project must name public or submitted evidence, a falsifiable diagnosis, a spatial action, a drawing or section, and a stop condition. Unknown facts remain null and block activation.

items.diagnosis: The conceptual commons spine and three east-west stitches are not an as-built continuity record.
items.design_action: Publish a six-segment gap atlas and field-audit route before capital work.
items.stop_condition: Missing provenance or inaccessible ordinary route keeps AI and capital work off.

items.diagnosis: River, mobility infrastructure and provisional geometry do not yet prove a continuous public-garden interface.
items.design_action: Test three conditional interfaces and preserve the ordinary garden plus separate logistics.
items.stop_condition: Blocked clear route, absent operator or unresolved river/fire control restores the ordinary garden.

items.diagnosis: Dense near-campus carriers do not prove public ground-floor access or a cleared rights chain.
items.design_action: Audit candidate ground floors and permit a distributed source-rights-withdrawal sequence only where access is verified.
items.stop_condition: Unclear source, missing withdrawal or blocked passage restores a non-AI public display.

items.diagnosis: The public station study window and organizer-side provisional key-area geometry do not coincide. Public-map roads and railways are now registered for desktop conflict screening, while official road redlines and engineering relationships remain pending.
items.design_action: Reconcile geometry first, then procure a low-regret dual-staff ground-service chain that does not substitute for permanent connection engineering.
items.stop_condition: Any unresolved siting conflict, failed handover, unavailable appeal or blocked route prevents activation.

items.diagnosis: A shared governance schema does not prove that any of the three different sites is spatially ready.
items.design_action: Attach each passport to its own verified place, ordinary baseline and expiring permit.
items.stop_condition: Any missing PASS condition keeps AI off at that site.

items.diagnosis: Textual statutory rules and officially reported asset types exist, but official attachments, control points and individual asset coordinates are absent.
items.design_action: Maintain a four-layer register and apply inventory, coordinate, collision, heritage-sign-off and restoration gates.
items.stop_condition: No design intrusion until the five heritage gates close.

items.diagnosis: A digital-service concept is not publicly usable without an independently staffed, physically accessible appeal route.
items.design_action: Co-site a paper-access and appeal desk only after the Dazhongsi geometry reconciliation.
items.stop_condition: Unavailable independent appeal pauses linked scenarios while the ordinary staffed desk remains.

items.diagnosis: A corridor-wide programme cannot use festival visibility or AI scoring to compensate for unresolved site evidence.
items.design_action: Run only annual pilots with named owners, site-specific geometry evidence, rights clearance and published failure records.
items.stop_condition: No named owner, site permit or rights clearance cancels the AI programme while ordinary public use continues.
